story.title: The Permanent Stain
story.logline: A man discovers that every lie he has ever told has literally turned his skin a shade darker, until only one truth remains.
story.twist: The final shade isn't from a lie, but from the brutal truth he kept hidden to protect someone.
story.ending: Are you brave enough to see your true colors?

scenes.narration: My skin was pure white until the day I lied about my mother's cooking, and it turned gray.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of 25-year-old Leo with messy brown hair and a white cotton t-shirt, staring in a dimly lit bathroom mirror at a gray patch on his jaw.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up tracking the edge of the gray skin.

scenes.narration: At first, I thought it was a rash. Then I lied to my boss about traffic, and my entire neck darkened.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of 25-year-old Leo with messy brown hair and a white t-shirt, touching his dark neck in panic inside a sterile office cubicle.

scenes.narration: Every small untruth added another layer of charcoal to my body. Society quickly invented a cruel name for us.
scenes.visual_prompt: POV shot of 25-year-old Leo with messy brown hair wearing a white t-shirt walking down a city street, people staring at his dark hands.

scenes.narration: The Stainers. We were the walking archives of deceit. We couldn't hide behind smiles anymore because our faces betrayed us.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of 25-year-old Leo with messy brown hair and a white t-shirt looking at his deeply stained charcoal-black hands under fluorescent lights.

scenes.narration: I swore I would never speak another falsehood. I became obsessively honest, keeping my chest pale and clear.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of 25-year-old Leo with messy brown hair, pulling down the collar of his white t-shirt to reveal a patch of pale skin on his chest.

scenes.narration: Until tonight. My sister stood in my kitchen, begging to know if her runaway husband was safe.
scenes.visual_prompt: Interior kitchen, 25-year-old Leo with messy brown hair and a white t-shirt standing opposite a crying woman in dim lighting.

scenes.narration: I knew he was dead. I had found his car in a ravine three days ago. But I looked into her eyes.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of 25-year-old Leo with messy brown hair and a white t-shirt swallowing hard, sweat beading on his forehead.

scenes.narration: And I smiled. I lied, telling her he called me from another state, just to spare her breaking heart.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of 25-year-old Leo with messy brown hair and a white t-shirt forcing a gentle smile while holding the crying woman's hands.

scenes.narration: The moment the lie left my lips, a sharp burning spread across my chest. I rushed to the bathroom.
scenes.visual_prompt: Interior bathroom, 25-year-old Leo with messy brown hair ripping off his white t-shirt, gasping in horror.

scenes.narration: My entire body turned pitch black. The biggest lie of my life wasn't a sin; it was pure love.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of 25-year-old Leo with messy brown hair, his skin now completely obsidian black, staring with glowing tears into the mirror.
scenes.camera: Slow zoom out to absolute darkness.

caption.hook: Every lie painted his skin a little darker.
caption.title: The Permanent Stain
caption.caption:
Deception leaves a mark we can't wash off. But sometimes, the darkest truth isn't a lie at all—it's the mercy we kept hidden.

What is your deepest secret costing you?
